html:
The leader of the Nationalist party, the Kuomintang, who ruled the Republic of China from 1928, fought Japan and the Communists, and after losing the civil war in 1949 ruled Taiwan until his death in 1975.

Born in Zhejiang, he trained as a soldier in Japan and became a follower of Sun Yat-sen, who made him head of the new Whampoa military academy in 1924. After Sun died, Chiang led the Northern Expedition of 1926 to 1928 against the warlords. In 1927 he turned on his Communist allies and had thousands killed in Shanghai, then set up his government at Nanjing.

His rule never reached the whole country. Japan seized Manchuria in 1931 and invaded China in full in 1937. Chiang led the long resistance, retreating to Chongqing, and China became one of the Allies of the Second World War.

After 1945 the civil war resumed, and Mao Zedong's Communists won. Chiang's government and army made the retreat to Taiwan, where he ruled under martial law, still claiming to be the government of all China.
sum: The leader of the Nationalist party, the Kuomintang, who ruled the Republic of China from 1928, fought Japan and the Communists, and after losing the civil war in 1949 ruled Taiwan until his death in 1975.
